description: This file contains core functions for the PTM driver specific to the Danube platform, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and control functions for the PP32 processor.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version's major and minor numbers.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes hardware components for the PTM chip, including PMU, PPE reset, EMA, mailbox, ATM traffic control, and share buffer.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_uninit_chip
methods.description: Uninitializes hardware components, primarily disabling PMU.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Downloads firmware to PP32 and starts its execution.
